description.value:
Every Academy student trains until they can pull a kunai or shuriken from their pouch without looking. While this cantrip is active, you Interact to draw a thrown weapon as a free action once per turn (instead of a single action), and your thrown Strikes ignore the first 10 feet of range increment for purposes of cover.

You must Sustain this cantrip each round to keep it active; it expires automatically after 1 minute or if you become unconscious.
